headline: President Bush ends national emergencies related to Yugoslavia and changes an earlier 2001 order on the Western Balkans.
what_it_does: This order ends one or more national emergencies that earlier presidents had declared about Yugoslavia. Such emergencies are usually the legal basis for economic sanctions. The order also changes Executive Order 13219 from June 2001, which dealt with the Western Balkans region. The title alone does not explain exactly which rules were lifted or what the changes to the 2001 order say.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses and individuals dealing with Yugoslavia
who_it_affects.how: Ending the emergencies may remove legal limits that had applied to trade or money dealings tied to Yugoslavia.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups covered by the 2001 Western Balkans order
who_it_affects.how: The changes to Executive Order 13219 may affect who is subject to the sanctions it set up, though the title does not give details.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 28, 2003; the title does not state a separate effective date.
